You are on the support-desk Genkit app in this directory. Bug report: In the support chat a customer says "My order is A-1001." and then, in the same conversation, sends "What is the status of my order?". The follow-up fails: the chat cannot be picked up again by its session id, so the customer has to start over and repeat the order number. Single questions still get answered.
Find the root cause and fix it in the app's source. Then write `answer.json` in the project root: { "file": "<path of the file that had the bug>", "snippet": "<the exact broken text you replaced, copied verbatim, one line is enough>", "cause": "<one sentence>", "evidence": "<what shows this is the cause>" }. Don't change `package.json` or add dependencies.
